Hi Priya —

We can absolutely accept the project-prefixed pattern you described. For audit and playback purposes we ask for two things:

- A stable prefix that won't change across environments (e.g., finanalytics-redwood-).
- A short delimiter + index (e.g., finanalytics-redwood-sa-01) so we can map logs consistently across services.

I'll attach a quick naming-template and a short policy note for provisioning TTLs and keys. On SCIM: the workbook looks good — we'll propose a delta sync schedule (hourly window for initial sync, then 5-min deltas) unless you prefer daily.

Next: I'll drop the service-account-naming-template.md and ent-access-cutover-checklist.xlsx to this thread by EOD.

Team —

I took a pass at turning Monica's asks into specific engineering deliverables and dates. Please review and confirm ownership: 

1) SAML test import and validation (STG): Rishi — target 10/06. Deliverable: imported metadata, SAML test user, and assertion log capture.
2) SCIM mapping + delta plan: Rishi/Karthik — target 10/06 (initial), 10/08 (delta cadence finalized). Deliverable: updated scim-attribute-mapping.xlsx and sync runbook.

5) Runbook + SOW routing: Irene — prepare runbook draft and push DocuSign SOW link to external contact by 10/04.

I also called out the following constraints to discuss on the kickoff call:
- FINAnalytics requires session-timeout <= 24h and MFA for admin roles; we need to ensure our org policy flags these at cutover.
- Their staging environment only accepts traffic from whitelisted CIDR blocks; Karthik, confirm whether we need an intermediary NAT address.

I'll prepare the runbook outline and attach ent-access-cutover-checklist.xlsx to the external thread once internal sign-off is complete. Please reply with any date conflicts by EOD today.
